portals.generationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent pixel-art cosmetic atlas for a 2D multiverse game
Primary request: Create one original, highly detailed cosmetic design atlas inspired by the objective and official references for the 2002 film 28 Days Later: deserted London after the Rage plague, desperate survivor improvisation, infected red eyes, evacuation and analogue emergency broadcasts. Do not reproduce any official poster, logo, actor likeness, or protected character design.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for local removal in every transparent/empty area.
Style/medium: crisp high-detail 2D pixel art, dark survival-horror game UI, internally consistent scale and palette.
Composition/framing: exact portrait 2:3 sheet divided into a strict 4-column by 6-row grid of equal cells, no gutters and no visible grid lines. Rows 1-2 together form one coherent 4-cells-wide by 2-cells-high transparent HUD border: center completely empty green for gameplay, distressed emergency tape corners, London street-map geometry, broken CCTV brackets, red Rage-vein accents, dirty off-white medical markings, reserved safe zones and no opaque center. Row 3 contains exactly four left-to-right frames of a portal animation: a red infected pupil/vein aperture tears open and stabilizes. Row 4 contains exactly four left-to-right frames of a K.O. effect: CCTV desaturation, violent red pulse, shattered emergency chevrons, then blackout residue. Row 5 contains exactly four left-to-right frames of an introduction pose: the same generic anonymous survivor silhouette in practical improvised clothing enters alert, raises a blunt survival tool, settles into guard. Row 6 contains exactly four left-to-right frames of a victory pose: the same survivor checks the street, lowers the tool, breathes, then stands cautiously relieved. Keep every frame fully inside its cell with generous transparent padding and consistent feet/ground line for pose rows.
Lighting/mood: bleak overcast London, harsh red emergency glow, grainy early-digital-video mood.
Color palette: charcoal, dirty concrete gray, faded khaki, warning red, small cold-white highlights. Never use #00ff00 in the artwork.
Materials/textures: torn tape, scratched plastic, oxidized metal, cracked monitor glass, wet asphalt cues.
Constraints: background must be perfectly uniform #00ff00 with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation; crisp pixel edges; four distinct progressive frames in each animation row; same anonymous silhouette and proportions in pose frames; no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no trademarks, no watermark, no gore, no official biohazard symbol.
Avoid: poster composition, actor likenesses, official title typography, photorealism, smooth vector art, duplicated frames, opaque cell backgrounds, green fringe.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready keyed 2D game cosmetic atlas for the original universe "Aegea: War of the Moirai"
Primary request: create one EXACT 1024x1536 portrait sprite sheet divided conceptually into 4 equal columns by 6 equal rows, each cell exactly 256x256. This is a technical pilot atlas and the layout must be followed exactly.
Input images:
Image 1: visual-world reference only - Aegea backdrop; preserve its nocturnal Aegean archipelago mood, cliff temples, bronze machinery, blue grids and violet fate threads.
Image 2: lead-character reference only - Thaleia of Naxos; use her as the SAME consistent character in every intro and victory animation frame: athletic dark-haired Greek heroine, blue-and-white draped travel outfit with gold trim, sandals, blue ribbons, xiphos.
Image 3: supporting style reference only - Melantho the Unfinished Oracle; use her violet prophecy, gold laurel and branching-futures visual language in the UI and effects, but do not put her character in the animation rows.
Image 4: supporting material reference only - Doros Bronzehand; use his patinated bronze, turquoise inlays and sacred-automaton craftsmanship in the HUD and portal construction, but do not put his character in the animation rows.
Supporting local booster reference inspected separately: its concentric circular core, alternating Aegean-blue and prophecy-violet polygonal geometry, and strong framed breach-card silhouette inform the portal and central Moirai crest; render no booster text.
Style/medium: highly detailed crisp 16-bit/32-bit-inspired pixel art matching the supplied original Aegea game art; readable silhouettes; controlled pixel clusters; no painterly blur, no photorealism.
Palette: midnight navy #172a46 and near-black #03060d, Aegean blue #54a0ff, prophecy violet #9b59b6, old bronze and gold #b87333/#f4d35e, limestone ivory #d7c7a1, small turquoise patina accents #58c6c7. Never use #00ff00 inside any asset.
Technical canvas and background: the entire unused canvas and every gap must be a perfectly flat, uniform solid #00ff00 chroma-key background. No texture, gradient, vignette, floor, shadow, reflection, glow spill, panel border, labels, captions, watermark, or guide lines on the green. Leave at least 10 pixels of pure green separation around every independent sprite in animation rows. All content must stay inside its assigned row and cell; nothing may cross a row boundary.
EXACT ROW CONTENT, from top to bottom:

ROW 1, y=256..511: one coherent full-width PROFILE BANNER / HUD LOWER frame spanning the 1024x256 row, an elegant wide open frame combining limestone temple edges, patinated bronze loom mechanisms, labyrinth pathways and severable violet fate threads; clear transparent/open center for profile art and runtime UI; no text. ROW 2, y=512..767: FOUR isolated 256x256 PORTAL EFFECT frames, left-to-right animation phases: (1) dormant circular bronze fate loom with closed dark center, (2) opening ring as blue grid lines and violet threads wind around three spindles, (3) fully open Aegean rift with luminous blue-violet vortex and bronze Greek meander rim, (4) collapsing ring with clean cut fate threads and bronze sparks. ROW 5, y=1280..1535: FOUR isolated 256x256 VICTORY POSE animation frames of that SAME Thaleia, full body and consistent identity, left-to-right: (1) low guarded stance after battle, (2) rises and gathers three severed violet threads, (3) raises xiphos with the free threads spiraling in blue-violet arcs, (4) stable heroic victory pose, xiphos upright, free thread forming an open non-closed fourth path behind her.
